evidence_policy: Primary normative and official evidence establishes the concern and data need; exact formulas, rules, thresholds, scenarios, and actions require jurisdiction/product/entity-specific adjudication.
completion_claim: Broad sourced candidate coverage only; not an exhaustive or adjudicated universal inventory.
open_gates: Twenty-five independent primary sources are not present for each individual subindustry label.
Clause-level traceability from every formula, threshold, input, and action to exact source sections is incomplete.
Licensed and proprietary scheme, FMI, venue, vendor, bureau, catastrophe-model, treaty, filing, and market-data specifications must be bound during implementation.
Jurisdiction-specific legal, prudential, accounting, privacy, conduct, tax, insolvency, and reporting conflicts require adjudication.
Digital-assets, stablecoin, open-finance, and BNPL sources require high-frequency freshness review.
Empirical performance claims require confidential or synthetic validation data and formal model governance.
